model.name: RS-Python - Architecture
model.documentation: Architecture of RS-Python, the Copernicus Reference System Python, deployed on OVHcloud. Built from the RS-PYTHON GitHub organisation (https://github.com/RS-PYTHON) and the online documentation (https://home.rs-python.eu/rs-documentation/). ArchiMate 3.2 notation.

element.name: End User
element.documentation: Data operator or analyst: searches, stages and processes Sentinel products by running the existing flows, then views and downloads the generated products.

element.name: Flow Developer
element.documentation: Processing chain developer or IVV engineer: customises the processing, writes custom Prefect flows and integrates new processors.

element.name: Operator
element.documentation: Monitors the platform and the production (flows, processing, performance indicators) with a subset of the administration tools.

element.name: Administrator
element.documentation: Deploys and maintains the platform, manages the user accounts and rights, initialises the processing environment and supports the users.

element.name: Security Officer
element.documentation: Supervises the security of the platform: intrusion detection, vulnerabilities, container security.

element.name: EOPF project (ESA)
element.documentation: Earth Observation Processing Framework project: develops the re-engineered DPR processors and the CPM.

element.name: Sentinel-1/-2/-3 satellites
element.documentation: Copernicus Sentinel satellites, whose raw data is downlinked to the acquisition ground stations.

element.name: External Data Search
element.documentation: Search the raw data sessions (CADIP), auxiliary data (AUXIP) and products (PRIP) of the Copernicus ground segment with the STAC API.

element.name: Data Staging
element.documentation: Copy products from the external data sources into the RS-Python object storage and catalog (OGC API - Processes).

element.name: Product Catalog
element.documentation: Search, read and manage the products with the STAC API (and the OData PRIP interface).

element.name: Product Download & Storage Access
element.documentation: Personal S3 credentials (OSAM), direct access to the buckets and download of the assets with pre-signed URLs.

element.name: Product Processing
element.documentation: Run the DPR processors and the conversions on Dask clusters (OGC API - Processes).

element.name: Workflow Orchestration
element.documentation: Run, schedule, chain and monitor the processing flows (Prefect), on demand or systematically.

element.name: Virtual Environment
element.documentation: JupyterHub workspace with the client libraries, Dask clusters, Swagger page and STAC browsers.

element.name: Platform Administration & Monitoring
element.documentation: User accounts and rights, API keys, monitoring dashboards, security monitoring, backups.

element.name: RS-Python (Copernicus Reference System Python)
element.documentation: System of Interest: open-source software solution to implement, deploy, operate and monitor Copernicus Sentinel data processing workflows based on the EOPF processors. Deployed on OVHcloud.

element.name: RS-Python Web Services (rs-server, rs-dpr-service)
element.documentation: Web services exposed behind the single domain rspy.<domain>, protected by authentication and fine-grained authorisation, documented in a single Swagger page.

element.name: rs-server-frontend
element.documentation: Serves the aggregated Swagger page / OpenAPI specification of all the services (built at CI time).

element.name: rs-server-cadip
element.documentation: STAC API on the CADIP acquisition stations (raw data sessions), translated into OData requests.

element.name: rs-server-adgs (AUXIP)
element.documentation: STAC API on the AUXIP / ADGS instances (auxiliary data files).

element.name: rs-server-prip
element.documentation: STAC API on the PRIP instances (Level-0, Level-1 and Level-2 products).

element.name: rs-server-catalog
element.documentation: STAC API of the RS-Python catalog (stac-fastapi-pgstac) with ownership, authorisation, asset checks, download with pre-signed URLs, lifecycle and OData PRIP interface.

element.name: rs-server-staging
element.documentation: OGC API - Processes service (pygeoapi) with the 'staging' process, run on the staging Dask cluster.

element.name: rs-server-osam
element.documentation: Object Storage Access Manager: synchronises the S3 accounts and access policies with the Keycloak roles and delivers the personal S3 credentials.

element.name: rs-dpr-service
element.documentation: OGC API - Processes service (pygeoapi) that runs the DPR processors on their Dask clusters, one image per Python and Dask version.

element.name: STAC Browsers (catalog, CADIP, AUXIP, PRIP)
element.documentation: Radiant Earth STAC Browser web interfaces of the catalog and of the stations.

element.name: Prefect Orchestrator
element.documentation: Prefect 3 server (API, UI, automations) and Kubernetes workers of the integrated, sandbox and monitoring work pools.

element.name: Prefect Server (API, UI, automations)
element.documentation: Prefect 3 server, with its PostgreSQL database, protected by Keycloak.

element.name: Prefect Workers (integrated, sandbox, monitoring)
element.documentation: Prefect Kubernetes workers: start the flow runs as Kubernetes jobs.

element.name: Processing Flows (rs-workflows, rs-client-libraries)
element.documentation: Prefect flows (search, staging, processing, conversion, operation) deployed by rs-workflow-deployment, calling the services with the rs-client-libraries and an API key.

element.name: JupyterHub
element.documentation: One JupyterLab session per user, with the RS-Python libraries and one kernel per Dask version.

element.name: Dask Gateway
element.documentation: Creates and scales the Dask clusters, with the JupyterHub authentication.

element.name: Dask Clusters
element.documentation: Dask schedulers and workers running the staging tasks and the DPR processors.

element.name: Staging Dask Cluster
element.documentation: Dask cluster of the staging service: parallel download of the assets into the object storage.

element.name: DPR Dask Clusters (EOPF CPM and DPR processors)
element.documentation: One Dask cluster per processor: S1 L0, S3 L0, S1 ARD, S3 L1/L2 OLCI, SAFE to Zarr conversion, mockup.

element.name: Keycloak (IAM)
element.documentation: Identity and access management: user accounts, groups, roles, OAuth2 / OpenID Connect.

element.name: API Key Manager
element.documentation: Creates, renews and revokes the API keys that carry the identity and rights of the users (csgroup-oss/apikey-manager).

element.name: Monitoring Stack (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Alloy)
element.documentation: Observability of the platform: logs, metrics, traces, dashboards and alerts.

element.name: Grafana Alloy
element.documentation: Collects the logs and the OpenTelemetry traces.

element.name: Loki
element.documentation: Logs of all the pods.

element.name: Tempo
element.documentation: Traces, from the Prefect flows to the services and Dask workers.

element.name: Prometheus
element.documentation: Metrics of the cluster, nodes and pods.

element.name: Grafana
element.documentation: Dashboards, exploration of logs, metrics, traces, alerts.

element.name: Security Monitoring (Wazuh, NeuVector)
element.documentation: Intrusion detection and container security, deployed from a non-public repository.

element.name: Wazuh
element.documentation: Intrusion detection, security events, vulnerability detection.

element.name: NeuVector
element.documentation: Container and Kubernetes runtime security.

element.name: GitLab Runner (EOPF CPM CI)
element.documentation: GitLab runner that runs the EOPF CPM tests on the cluster.

element.name: RS-Python Web API & Swagger (rspy.<domain>)
element.documentation: HTTPS REST API: STAC API (/cadip, /auxip, /prip, /catalog), OGC API - Processes (/processes, /dpr), OData, /storage, /auth, Swagger (/docs). OAuth2 cookie or x-api-key header.

element.name: Products & Auxiliary Data Files (S3 buckets)
element.documentation: Raw data (CADU), auxiliary data files, Level-0 to Level-2 products (Zarr, SAFE), payloads, reports, quicklooks, stored under <bucket>/<owner>/<collection>/.

element.name: Bucket Configuration
element.documentation: CSV table owner, collection, product type, expiration delay, bucket.

element.name: CADIP Stations
element.documentation: CADU Interface delivery Points of the Copernicus acquisition ground stations: raw data sessions (OData API).

element.name: AUXIP (ADGS)
element.documentation: Auxiliary Data Gathering Service: auxiliary data files (OData API).

element.name: PRIP (Production Services)
element.documentation: Production service Interface delivery Points: Level-0, Level-1 and Level-2 products (OData API).

element.name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE)
element.documentation: Public STAC API and S3 object storage of the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem.

element.name: DestinE EarthDataHub
element.documentation: Destination Earth data lake: public STAC API, e.g. Copernicus Digital Elevation Model.

element.name: OVHcloud API
element.documentation: API of the cloud provider, used by OSAM to manage the object storage users, keys and access policies.

element.name: GitHub (code, CI, GHCR, Helm repository, PyPI publication)
element.documentation: Source code, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), public Docker images (ghcr.io/rs-python), Helm charts, documentation.

element.name: EOPF CPM GitLab
element.documentation: gitlab.eopf.copernicus.eu: EOPF CPM and DPR processors source code and CI.

element.name: Compute & Network (VMs, load balancers, private networks, NFS)
OVHcloud - Public Cloud project, region GRA (Gravelines, France)
OVHcloud Control Panel (web + 2FA) & APIs (OVHcloud, OpenStack)
element.documentation: Management plane of the cloud provider, operated by OVHcloud.

element.documentation: OpenStack instance on Ext-Net; security group: SSH 22/tcp from the whitelisted IP addresses only (company and contractor sites).

element.name: Load Balancer (ops) - public IP, HTTPS 443
element.documentation: OVHcloud Public Cloud Load Balancer created by Kubernetes for the Envoy Gateway service: single entry point of all the web services.

element.name: Managed Kubernetes Cluster (ops) - OVHcloud MKS
element.documentation: Managed Kubernetes cluster on the private network, Kubernetes API restricted to the bastion IP address.

element.name: Managed Private Registry (ops) - Harbor

element.name: Shared File System (ops) - Manila NFS
element.documentation: OpenStack Manila NFS shares for the ReadWriteMany volumes.

element.name: Router (ops) - outgoing traffic (SNAT)
element.documentation: Router of the private network: gives the outgoing Internet access to the cluster nodes.

element.documentation: OpenStack instance on Ext-Net; security group: SSH 22/tcp from the whitelisted IP addresses only (company and contractor sites).

element.name: Load Balancer (dev) - public IP, HTTPS 443
element.documentation: OVHcloud Public Cloud Load Balancer created by Kubernetes for the Envoy Gateway service: single entry point of all the web services.

element.name: Managed Kubernetes Cluster (dev) - OVHcloud MKS
element.documentation: Managed Kubernetes cluster on the private network, Kubernetes API restricted to the bastion IP address.

element.name: Managed Private Registry (dev) - Harbor
element.documentation: OVHcloud managed Harbor registry: private images that must never be public, proxy cache of the public registries.

element.name: Shared File System (dev) - Manila NFS
element.documentation: OpenStack Manila NFS shares for the ReadWriteMany volumes.

element.name: Router (dev) - outgoing traffic (SNAT)
element.documentation: Router of the private network: gives the outgoing Internet access to the cluster nodes.

element.documentation: Pods scheduled with the node-role.kubernetes.io/prefect_flow label.

element.documentation: S3-compatible object storage of the project, shared by the two environments (buckets prefixed by the cluster name).

CDSE and DestinE EarthDataHub - HTTPS endpoints
Project laptops (company) - latest Ubuntu LTS, full-disk encryption
element.documentation: Secured project laptops (physical security and disk encryption), the only workstations allowed for the development and operation activities.

FP1 - External Data Access
element.documentation: Search, in read-only mode, the data of the Copernicus ground segment and of the data spaces. rs-server translates the STAC API requests into OData requests to the stations, and the OData responses into STAC items.

property.value: rs-server-cadip, rs-server-adgs, rs-server-prip, rs-client-libraries (CdseClient, EarthDataHubClient), STAC browsers (CADIP, AUXIP, PRIP)

element.name: Search CADIP raw data sessions
element.documentation: STAC API on the CADIP acquisition stations: sessions as items, files as assets.

element.name: Search auxiliary data (AUXIP)
element.documentation: STAC API on the AUXIP / ADGS instances: one item per auxiliary data file.

element.name: Search production products (PRIP)
element.documentation: STAC API on the PRIP instances: Level-0, Level-1 and Level-2 products.

element.name: STAC / OData mapping
element.documentation: Translation of the requests, virtual collections, product type mapping to EOPF types.

element.name: Search CDSE and EarthDataHub
element.documentation: Direct STAC search of the CDSE and DestinE EarthDataHub by the client library.

element.name: FP2 - Data Staging
element.documentation: Copy products from the external data sources into the RS-Python object storage, and publish their STAC items in the catalog (OGC API - Processes service, run on a Dask cluster).

property.value: rs-server-staging, staging Dask cluster, Dask Gateway, staging flows (rs-workflows)

element.name: Staging job management
element.documentation: OGC API - Processes: start, follow, dismiss staging jobs.

element.name: Parallel asset transfer
element.documentation: Download of the assets from the stations (HTTPS) or the CDSE (S3) on the staging Dask cluster.

element.name: Write to object storage
element.documentation: Store the assets in the bucket given by the bucket configuration.

element.name: Catalog publication
element.documentation: Publish the STAC items, with assets referencing the object storage, in a catalog collection.

element.name: FP3 - Catalog & Data Management
element.documentation: STAC catalog of the products managed by RS-Python (raw data, auxiliary data, Level-0 to Level-2 products), stored in PostgreSQL / pgstac, with ownership, fine access rights and data lifecycle.

property.value: rs-server-catalog, pgstac database (CloudNativePG), STAC browser (catalog), object storage

element.name: Collections & items management
element.documentation: Create, read, update, delete collections and items (STAC API transactions).

element.name: Spatio-temporal search
element.documentation: STAC API search with spatial, temporal and CQL2 metadata filters.

element.name: Ownership & access control
element.documentation: Collections owned by users; rs_catalog_<owner>:<collection>_<right> roles.

element.name: Asset download
element.documentation: Redirection to temporary pre-signed URLs of the object storage.

element.name: Data lifecycle
element.documentation: Timestamps and expiration of the items according to the bucket configuration.

element.name: OData PRIP interface
element.documentation: Exposure of the catalog products with the OData interface of the ESA PRIP.

element.name: FP4 - Object Storage Access Management
element.documentation: Keep the object storage accounts and access policies of the users consistent with their catalog rights, and deliver their personal S3 credentials.

property.value: rs-server-osam, OVHcloud API, OVHcloud Object Storage, OSAM operation flows

element.name: S3 accounts synchronisation
element.documentation: Create / delete the object storage accounts according to the Keycloak accounts.

element.name: Access policy computation
element.documentation: Compute and apply the bucket/folder access policies from the catalog roles.

element.name: S3 credentials delivery
element.documentation: Return the personal S3 credentials of the user.

element.name: Bucket configuration
element.documentation: Serve the bucket configuration (owner, collection, product type, expiration, bucket).

element.name: FP5 - Product Processing
element.documentation: Run the EOPF DPR processors (Sentinel-1, -2, -3) and the SAFE to Zarr conversion on Dask clusters, through an OGC API - Processes service.

property.value: rs-dpr-service, DPR Dask clusters (EOPF CPM and processors), Dask Gateway, processing flows

element.name: Task table & payload generation
element.documentation: Retrieve the task tables and compute the EOPF payload files.

element.name: Processor execution on Dask
element.documentation: Trigger the processor (eopf trigger) on the Dask cluster of the processor.

element.name: Job monitoring & cancellation
element.documentation: Status, progress, log streaming and cancellation of the processing jobs.

element.name: SAFE / Zarr conversion
element.documentation: Conversion of the legacy SAFE products and auxiliary files to Zarr.

element.name: Quicklook generation
element.documentation: Generation of the quicklooks of the Sentinel-3 OLCI products.

element.name: FP6 - Workflow Orchestration
element.documentation: Implement, schedule, chain and monitor the processing chains as Prefect flows, on demand or systematically.

element.name: Custom flow development

element.name: Performance indicators

element.name: Product browsing

view.name: 1. System in Context
view.documentation: RS-Python as a black box: the services it provides, the user roles that consume them, the external systems that interact with it and the providers it relies on. ArchiMate viewpoint: Layered.

node.label: System of Interest in blue (black box) with the services it provides; external systems and providers in grey. Roles are served by the System of Interest (labels: services used).

view.name: 2. Functional Top-Level Decomposition
view.documentation: Functional packages of RS-Python (application functions) and their functions (nested: composition). Each package realizes the RS-Python services it supports. The components assigned to each package are listed in the documentation of the package. ArchiMate viewpoint: Service Realization.

node.label: Functional packages and functions are application functions (nesting = composition). Dotted arrows: realization of the RS-Python services. Allocation of the components: see the table of the dossier.

view.name: 3. High Level Application View
view.documentation: Application components of RS-Python and their information flows, between themselves, with the user roles (through the external interfaces, in orange) and with the external systems (in grey). ArchiMate viewpoint: Layered.

node.label: All the web UIs authenticate the users with Keycloak (OAuth2 / OIDC); scripts and flows use API keys. All the components send their logs, metrics and OpenTelemetry traces to the monitoring stack.
Orange: external interfaces of RS-Python, exposed in HTTPS by the Envoy Gateway load balancer. Grey: external systems.

view.name: 4. Detailed Application View
view.documentation: Detailed application components of RS-Python (micro-services, virtual environment, IAM, monitoring), their interfaces (external ones in orange), their data and their information flows. ArchiMate viewpoint: Layered.

node.label: All the web UIs and APIs authenticate the users with Keycloak (OAuth2 / OIDC) or with an API key (x-api-key header), and check their Keycloak roles.
Logs, metrics and OpenTelemetry traces of all the components are collected by Alloy and Prometheus. Wazuh and NeuVector agents run on all the nodes. Grafana also reads the PostgreSQL databases.
Orange: external interfaces (all exposed by Envoy Gateway in HTTPS). Grey: external systems.

view.name: 5. Infrastructure Logical View
view.documentation: Infrastructure instances of RS-Python on OVHcloud with their software, the deployment of the application components on the node pools, and the technical flows. ArchiMate viewpoint: Implementation and Deployment.

node.label: The dev cluster has the same node pools, software and deployment as the ops cluster, with a smaller sizing. Intra-cluster flows (Envoy Gateway to the services, services to databases and Dask) use the Kubernetes pod network.

view.name: 6. Network View
view.documentation: Network zones (groupings), networks, nodes and network flows (protocols, ports, filtering) of the RS-Python platform on OVHcloud. ArchiMate viewpoint: Technology.

node.label: Filtering (OpenStack security groups and MKS IP restrictions): - bastion: SSH 22/tcp from the company and contractor IP addresses only - load balancer: HTTPS 443 from the Internet - Kubernetes API: 6443/tcp from the bastion IP address only Managed services (object storage, registries, OVHcloud APIs) expose authenticated public HTTPS endpoints, reached by the cluster nodes through the router.
Same network design and filtering as the production environment. Administration through the dev bastion only.
